string.text: Keeps rich snowfall active at all times outdoors (when Project INVERNO is installed), cycling smoothly between thick snowflakes, heavy snow, and blizzards without dry clear gaps.
Enable Dynamic Snow & Frost on Weapons
Accumulates realistic 3D frost and snow crystals on upward-facing surfaces of your weapon and gloves outdoors, shaking slightly on recoil and melting indoors or near campfires.
Carves real-time 3D parallax snow trenches with raised side berms and directional bootprints that gradually fill back in as snow continues to fall.
Nearby stalkers and mutants (within 35m) leave directional boot and species-scaled paw trails in the snow so you can track them across the Zone.
Controls how long footprints and craters stay visible before falling snow buries them (1.0 = ~45s in blizzards up to ~140s in light snow).
Lit campfires gradually melt surrounding 3D snow into dark wet earth and glistening slush. Once extinguished, fresh snowfall slowly buries the firepit again.
Maximum radius around a burning campfire where 3D snow melts away.
Enable Snow Craters & Tree Snow Shake
Gunshots and explosions churn craters in snow, kick up snow dust, and shake falling snow cascades loose from tree branches.
